paragraphs.text: Juggernaut is a creature type used for large, mercilessly destructive, and unstoppable forces or objects. All Juggernauts are artifact creatures .

The first creature to bear the type was the original Juggernaut in Alpha . Other examples include Mishra's War Machine , Urza's Engine , Keldon Battlewagon , and Phyrexian Juggernaut . Juggernauts typically can't be blocked by walls , attack each turn if able, and/or have trample .

Levelers were giant, merciless Juggernauts created by Memnarch that ripped through every corner of Mirrodin once each century. They killed Glissa 's family in one such attack, causing what became known as the Leveler War and later the Fifth Dawn . When Memnarch was deposed, they were left to wander the land, confused and leaderless, or fell silent. Many were captured and absorbed into New Phyrexia .
